      have hr := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi').2

    obtain ⟨ir, hir, hair⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (A.max'_mem hA)

    have hR := ih R hRlt (by
      intro p q hpq
      exact (Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset_filter _ hRS)).trans (hd p q hpq))
    have hUd : Disjoint
        (L.biUnion fun i => Finset.Icc (a i + 1) (a i + s))

      apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
